overview_description.description:
Bright Health Group is a health insurance company that delivers affordable healthcare to aging and underserved populations. Bright Health aims to improve the healthcare experience by leveraging technology to streamline operations and enhance member engagement. They focus on building partnerships with health systems and care providers to create integrated healthcare networks. By forming these partnerships, Bright Health seeks to offer its members a more personalized and coordinated healthcare experience.

The company differentiates itself by utilizing data analytics and digital tools to help both its members and healthcare providers make more informed decisions about healthcare. They strive to simplify the complexities of health insurance and improve access to quality care for their customers.
